QueryHawk is your expert querying companion, ready to take you on a data-driven journey to land your manuscript in the right agent's hands.

Become a founding writerSee how it works

No more winging it.

Ready for a bird's-eye view of your entire querying campaign?

Every query tracked, from start to finish

A full history for everything you've sent, plus timely nudge reminders so that nothing slips through the cracks.

Your agents on file

Not just a name and an email. Their wish list, their response time, the specific sample they ask for — and a timeline of every interaction you've had with them.

Your list so far comes with you

Spreadsheet? Notes? All in your head? We have two handy methods for bringing your querying history with you — or, of course, the option to start from scratch.

Curate and compare with Submission Packages

Bundle your query letters, synopses and manuscript samples into packages. Attach them to queries and see which combinations or materials are generating most interest.

Updates log themselves with Smart Email Drop

Sent another query? Had a reply? Copy and paste a sent or received email and QueryHawk will suggest the updates needed. Don't worry — you'll always have final say.

Compile your Comparable Titles

Build a library of comparable titles and add them to your query letters to position yourself in the market. Track which ones resonate, and have the Scout suggest new ones for your reading list.

Our vision is simple.

Get good stories told.

A captivating story should never be lost to a sub-par querying campaign. There's a dangerous skills gap between writing and querying. QueryHawk bridges that gap.

Make querying simple.

Stop shooting from the hip. We'll crunch the data and give you everything you need to make targeted decisions at the right time.

Let writers write.

Less time trawling through spreadsheets, more time doing what you love.

What stays exactly as it is

  • Every word. Nothing is rewritten.
  • The layout. Same sections in the same order at the same sizes.
  • Every drawing. The six feature pictures, the three vision drawings and the two hawks are your existing files. Nothing to commission.
  • The hero. It stays light, with your shadow artwork exactly as it is and the navy button it has today.

For you to check

  • The wordmark. Your nav and footer use the dark wordmark artwork. On ink it needs a cream version, or live text as drawn here.
  • The hero's corners. It rises under the ink bar with rounded top corners, as the sheet does under the app's bar. Say if you'd rather it met the bar square.
  • The two hawks stay on oat, beside the navy panel, because they were drawn for a light ground.
  • The vision drawings sit on white cards. They were drawn for white, and the stone band needs something lighter on it.
  • The six feature pictures still show the app's earlier dress. That is unchanged from today and would need new artwork.
  • Only the landing page is drawn. About, Pricing, Founders, Contact and the legal pages would take the same colours.
